selection_reason: Wait gates regressed in exploration. Long-lead gate preserved outcomes and added a small margin on one exploration seed; this is insufficient evidence of improvement.
promotion_requirements: Candidate wins more head-to-head games than it loses against matched6
At least one paired external outcome improvement and zero external outcome regressions
Positive sum of paired external margin differences
No reported errors/fallbacks and every candidate decision under 1000 ms
If these pass, confirm with the official engine on additional seeds before any release
note: A bounded experimental gate, not a statistical guarantee of improvement or leaderboard rating. Seats within a seed are dependent.
